note: Raw palette-index outputs of the DC6/DCC/DT1 decoders compared with independently encoded intent (scripts/equivalence/decoder_cases.py) and authored DT1 bytes. Original-game decoder captures (DCC seeds 0x140a0/0x13b70/0x13780 are discovery seeds, not callable APIs) are not bound yet.

interface.probe: test_visual_reference_probe decode --kind dt1|dcc|dc6 --input PATH --direction N --out-dir PATH
interface.origin: signed sprite-space position of pixel (0,0), rows top-down
interface.dc6_frames: each frame at its own size; origin_y = offsetY - height + 1
interface.dcc_frames: every frame of a direction at the direction box; origin = box minimum
interface.dt1_frames: one per block, the editor's block image (zero line placed by orientation), origin (0,0)

assumptions.assumed: the DC6 frame 'flip' dword is not interpreted; rows are always bottom-up
assumptions.evidence_needed: a vanilla DC6 frame with flip=1 (140 exist) rendered by the original game
assumptions.attempted: 2026-10-22: not settled in package D task 4's pass.
